The '''Lorahns system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] near the [[Gamor Run/Legends|Gamor Run]] located within the [[Sarka sector/Legends|Sarka sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. This system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lorahns/Legends|Lorahns]].
